name: Flight
description: Fly upward for 10 seconds and steer left and right. Gongs cannot hurt you. Tap again to add 10 more seconds.

name: Rocket
description: Auto-climb 20 floors in about 4 seconds. Gongs cannot hurt you. Tap again to add 20 more floors. Stops before the last floors of a level.

name: Double Jump
description: For 20 seconds you can jump once more in mid-air. Tap again to add 20 seconds.

name: Wall Stick
description: For 20 seconds you stick to the side walls for up to 1.5 seconds. Jump to leap off. Tap again to add 20 seconds.

name: Shield
description: Gongs cannot hurt you for 20 seconds. Tap again to add 20 seconds.

name: Safety Net
description: Arm it any time before a fall. The next time you fall, it jumps you up 3 floors. Arm the next one after a rescue. Not timed.

name: Glide Cape
description: For 20 seconds the whole game slows to half speed after every jump until you land, so you can steer to the next platform. Tap again to add 20 seconds.

name: Wide Platforms
description: For 20 seconds every platform is 20 percent wider to land on. Tap again to add 20 seconds.

name: Slow Time
description: The rising danger zone moves 50 percent slower for 30 seconds. Tap again to add 30 seconds.

name: Spring Boots
description: The next 3 jumps are 20 percent higher.

name: Coin Doubler
description: Doubles the coins paid at the end of this level.

name: Star Seeker
description: Arrows at the screen edge point to stars you have not collected yet.
